sources.title: Road traffic injuries
sources.section: Non-use of motorcycle helmets, seat-belts and child restraints
facts: Wearing a seat belt can reduce the risk of death for people travelling in vehicles. It does not guarantee safety.

sources.title: Road traffic injuries
facts: Higher driving speeds are associated with a greater likelihood of crashes and more severe crash consequences.

sources.title: Road traffic injuries
facts: Using a mobile phone while driving can slow reactions and make lane control and following-distance management harder.

sources.title: Road traffic injuries
facts: Road safety requires coordinated attention to roads, vehicles, and road users. Raising public awareness is one part of prevention.
